title: ZCC forwarding profiles
aliases: how does zcc decide where to send traffic
traffic goes direct instead of through zscaler
why didn't zia see this traffic

prose.text: {{purpose}} "Where did this device's traffic go?" needs four questions answered in order.

steps.label: Which forwarding profile does the device run?
steps.text: The one its app profile selects, as of the last login or restart: [[zcc.forwarding-profiles.assignment]].

steps.label: Which network type was the device in?
steps.text: On-Trusted, VPN-Trusted, Split VPN-Trusted or Off-Trusted: [[zcc.forwarding-profiles.network-types]], decided for On-Trusted by the trusted network criteria in [[zcc.trusted-networks.detection]].

steps.label: What does the profile do on that network type?
steps.text: Separately for internet traffic and for Private Access: [[zcc.forwarding-profiles.internet-actions]], [[zcc.forwarding-profiles.private-access-actions]].

prose.text: When the app cannot protect traffic at all, the fail-open settings decide: [[zcc.forwarding-profiles.fail-open]]. Reading or writing profiles through the API, including the undocumented integer codes: [[zcc.api.forwarding-profile-wire]].

prose.label: Copying and finding profiles.
prose.text: {{copy}} Where the copy lands in the table conflicts with the default profile always being last, [[zcc.forwarding-profiles.assignment:default-profile]] {{divergence:copy-position}}. {{search}}

prose.label: Dedicated proxy port.
prose.text: Client Connector's dedicated proxy port page is described with the ZIA proxy ports: [[zia.forwarding-control.proxy-ports:client-connector-port]].

prose.label: Unified tunnel.
prose.text: Profiles can also carry an `enableUnifiedTunnel` flag and a unified tunnel list, whose entries each name a network type and carry separate ZIA and ZPA action codes: [[zcc.api.forwarding-profile-wire:unified-tunnel-shape]]. What unified tunnel mode changes for the device is open {{gap:unified-tunnel-semantics}}.

copy.statement: A forwarding profile can be copied and customized instead of configuring each setting in a new profile; the default profile cannot be copied, and a maximum of 10 profiles can be copied at the same time.

quotes: You can copy an existing Forwarding Profile and customize the profile to fit your needs, instead of having to configure each setting in a new profile.
You cannot copy the default profile.
You can copy a maximum of 10 profiles at the same time.

search.statement: The Forwarding Profile page can be searched by profile name, with Enter displaying the results.

quotes: In the Search by Profile Name field, enter search words and press Enter to display your search results.

purpose.statement: A forwarding profile tells Client Connector how to treat traffic from users' systems in different network environments, for the Internet & SaaS and Private Access services.

quotes: The forwarding profile tells Zscaler Client Connector how to treat traffic from your users' systems in different network environments for the Internet & SaaS and Private Access services.

copy-position.summary: The Copying a Forwarding Profile page says a copied profile appears at the bottom of the Forwarding Profile table, while About Forwarding Profiles says the default profile is always the last profile in the table.

quotes: Your copied profile appears at the bottom of the Forwarding Profile table.

positions.says: A copied profile appears at the bottom of the Forwarding Profile table.

quotes: It is always the last forwarding profile in the table on the Forwarding Profile page.

positions.says: The default forwarding profile is always the last profile in the table (existing claim zcc.forwarding-profiles.assignment:default-profile).

copy-position.impact: If copies go to the bottom, the default profile cannot always be last; the pages do not say which order the table shows after a copy.

unified-tunnel-semantics.title: What unified tunnel mode changes for the device
unified-tunnel-semantics.detail: Unverified legacy statement (inferred from the structure): ZIA and ZPA traffic share a single transport connection instead of two separate tunnels, with policy still separate per traffic kind. No captured help page describes unified tunnel.
unified-tunnel-semantics.blocks: explaining tunnel behavior on a profile with unified tunnel enabled

checks.do: Before reading ZIA policy for traffic ZIA never logged: which network type the device was in, and whether the profile's Internet & SaaS action for it is None, which tunnels nothing.
Whether the trusted network criteria matched where the user actually was, which puts the device On-Trusted and selects the On-Trusted actions.

When a Private Access application is not reached and its segment configuration looks right: the profile's Private Access action for the device's network type, which is set separately from the internet action and can be None.
